newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says forex intervention must be joint - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: MOF says forex intervention must be joint - Jiji.

text.p: Intervention in foreign exchange markets should be done jointly with other nations if it is to be effective, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency on Friday.
Mitsuzuka also said that Japan would intervene to stabilise currencies if foreign exchange movements were excessive, Jiji reported.

Mitsuzuka, who was speaking before a parliamentary panel, said it was important for stability that currency intervention be done not just by the U.S. and Japan alone, but also in cooperation with European nations, Jiji said.
